method_name: AutoTemplate core with source atom mapping
implementation: Unchanged upstream chemistry functions loaded by a Windows-compatible wrapper; not execution of the unmodified upstream CLI.
reference_pool: All 1808937 Lowe USPTO grant source reactions, including benchmark source records. Corpus-informed/transductive comparator, not independent external validation.
input_mapping: Original Lowe atom mapping, no RXNMapper or LocalMapper remapping
role_assignment: Classify the curated core by positive product-map overlap, then append upstream removed_reagents to the reagent role. This preserves the explicit reagent stream when original spectator map IDs collide with renumbered product IDs. Also report naive merged-SMILES classification as a sensitivity.
product_selection: First successful product in upstream preprocessed order
template_order: Descending merged frequency; stable source-row order for ties
seed: numpy seed = 20261027 + zero-based source or benchmark index; PYTHONHASHSEED=0
source_failures: All source rows recorded, with extraction failure, exception, timeout and worker-crash statuses; only validated reconstructable templates contribute frequency.
benchmark_failures: All 400 retained in denominators; exceptions, timeouts and worker crashes count as incorrect for both labels. They are not chemical rejection successes.
noise_prediction: retained => noise-free; completed no_template_match => noisy; execution failure => unresolved
primary_structure: Frozen Table 2 role-specific normalization and reactant multiplicity policy; denominator all 292 noise-free records; incomplete references and method failures cannot count as exact
secondary_structure: Frozen strict Table 2 endpoint and pooled reactant/reagent set sensitivity, reported separately
human_followup: Separate targeted 14-case blinded packet; no new independent human judgments yet
pilot: First 1000 source reactions for import/runtime and graph-merging parity checks only; no benchmark labels or scores used to choose settings
